दिग्गज डायरेक्टर SS Rajamouli ने फिल्म Ramayana का रिव्यू शेयर करके सोशल मीडिया पर हलचल बढ़ा दी है! 🔥

गुरुवार को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज हुई Nitesh Tiwari की फिल्म Ramayana को दर्शकों और सेलेब्स से जबरदस्त रिस्पॉन्स मिला है। X पर पोस्ट करते हुए SS Rajamouli ने लिखा कि बड़े पर्दे पर इस फिल्म के विजुअल्स और स्केल बेहद शानदार हैं। 🎬

उन्होंने Ranbir Kapoor को Rama के रोल में शांत मगर भव्य बताया, वहीं Yash को Ravana के रूप में खौफनाक और Sai Pallavi को Sita के रूप में ग्रेसफुल कहा। Rajamouli ने फिल्म के प्री-क्लाइमेक्स और क्लाइमेक्स की भी खूब तारीफ की। 👏

बता दें कि Namit Malhotra द्वारा प्रोड्यूस इस फिल्म में Hans Zimmer और AR Rahman का म्यूजिक है, जबकि इसका दूसरा पार्ट साल 2028 में रिलीज होगा।

क्या आपने थिएटर में Ramayana देख ली है, आपको फिल्म कैसी लगी? कमेंट्स में जरूर बताइए! 👇

ctx.title: SS Rajamouli reviews Ramayana, calls Ranbir Kapoor 'serene yet magnificent' as Rama, praises Yash and Sai Pallavi
ctx.summary: SS Rajamouli praised Ramayana’s scale and visuals, calling Ranbir Kapoor magnificent as Lord Rama.
ctx.text:
Ranbir Kapoor and Yash -starrer Ramayana hit theatres on Thursday and opened to positive reviews. Along with audiences, several celebrities from across film industries have praised the film. Celebrated filmmaker SS Rajamouli has also taken to social media to share his review of the film, calling Ranbir 'magnificent' in his portrayal of Lord Rama.
Taking to X (formerly Twitter), Rajamouli wrote, "#Ramayana… the sheer scale of the film and the visuals on the big screen are spectacular to watch. Ranbir as Rama, especially from the Vanavasam onwards, is serene yet magnificent. Yash brings a menacing presence as Ravana, while Sai Pallavi is graceful as Sita. The pre-climax and climax… loved every bit of it. Congratulations @malhotra_namit , @niteshtiwari22 and the entire team on bringing such an ambitious vision so beautifully to the screen. 🙏."
This isn't the first time Rajamouli has shown his support for the film. Earlier, when the film's trailer was released, the filmmaker shared it on social media and praised the team's vision. He wrote, “#Ramayana is a story every Indian storyteller grows up aspiring to tell. It's a joy to see @niteshtiwari22 and @malhotra_namit bring it to the screen on such a grand scale. Each actor brings these timeless characters to life with depth. Looking forward to 5th November. Best wishes to the entire team,” he added.
Rajamouli is also gearing up for his next highly anticipated film, Varanasi, starring Mahesh Babu and Priyanka Chopra. The filmmaker had earlier revealed that his upcoming film has a connection to the Ramayana. Speaking to Polygon, he said, "All my films are inspired by the epics of (Lord) Rama. In this film, I have a chance to actually take an actual episode from the Ramayana itself and present it in this way."
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra, Ramayana is a two-part cinematic adaptation of the ancient Indian epic. The film features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Ravi Dubey as Lakshman and Sunny Deol as Hanuman. The ensemble cast also includes Arun Govil, Lara Dutta, Rakul Preet Singh, Kajal Aggarwal and Vivek Oberoi, among others.
The project features music by Oscar-winning composers Hans Zimmer and AR Rahman, with visual effects handled by DNEG. The second part of the two-film adaptation will be released in 2028.
